comments.body:
Since tokens are precious I tend to look for methods to create assets that can be done locally, so instead of an AI making the asset, I instead tell the AI to make a tool that can do something cool locally, unlimited, standalone and free.

The above stuff is possible with just pure code, no expensive services needed.
